title: The AI Price War Just Got Brutal
concept: Market scoreboard: race countdown, model face-off cards, giant price slam, pressure meter, audience-impact close.
visual_language: High-contrast editorial finance aesthetic with stark obsidian, electric blue, and crisp typography optimized for 9:16 mobile display.
hook_visual: Aggressive typographic slam on a stark background announcing the open AI price war.
escalation: Rapid feature comparison leading into hard cost metrics and exponential market pressure build-up.
payoff: Broad human impact resolution focusing on accessible high-tier artificial intelligence.
constraints: No camera moves, zooms, or pans

motion_direction.rhythm: Fast-paced punchy beats aligning with rapid financial metrics.
motion_direction.staging_notes: All elements locked dead center within safe vertical bounds for mobile UI overlays.

audio_direction.music_direction: Minimalist electronic tension bed with low industrial hum and clean percussive hits.
audio_direction.narration_protection: Audio ducking applied during heavy percussive hits to maintain vocal clarity.

central_composition.focus: Vertical stack centered at x:50, y:50 with robust 85% width padding.
central_composition.depth: Layered flat cards with high-contrast shadows.

self_critique.compliance: Passed all format and rule checks. Strict vertical center alignment, precise duration alignment, allowed SFX tracks only.
self_critique.visual_variety: Strong diversity across full-bleed type, split comparison, product cards, stat counters, warning panel, and final question.
self_critique.pacing: Rapid editorial rhythm perfectly matched to financial token metrics and competitive narrative beats.
